target_property.description: Property or construct whose quantity the Metric defines

measurement_rule.description: Rule or procedure that derives a value from the target property

value_schema.description: JSON Schema for quantitative outputs, including the units, range, or dimensions needed to interpret them

mechanism: A definition of a quantitative property. It identifies the target property, the rule used to derive its values, and the value schema that makes those values interpretable. Applying the definition produces readings; observed values and their context are recorded separately rather than changing the definition.
gloss: Definition of a quantitative property and its value semantics
invariants: Quantitative Output: `value_schema` admits only numbers or finite structures whose leaves are numbers, and declares the units, range, or dimensions needed to interpret them.
